facts.fact: 深夜密谈场景：月光、床、椅子——像一场幽会的滑稽仿作；她教他「姨妈要的是 passion，不是鲜花巧克力」（原文 chocolates and flowers）。
facts.anchor: Speaking in the darkness, with moonlight filtering through the window, it felt like a parody of a lovers’ midnight rendezvous, him sitting on the bed and smoking a cigarette while she pulled up a chair and lounged close by.

facts.fact: 她交代情报来源：洗床单时看出 Plutarco 是姨妈的长期情人；「她喜欢有地位的人」。
facts.anchor: “I do the laundry. I took a look at the bedsheets,” she said simply.

facts.fact: 两家底细互换：有钱青年求娶的是母亲 Encarnación，母亲随 Rómulo 私奔，全家声名扫地、Inés 成私生女。
facts.anchor: “There was a wealthy young man, many years ago. He asked for my mother’s hand in marriage instead of hers and then my mother ran away with another man.

facts.fact: Ulises 的父亲史：让怀孕的母亲进教堂成亲只为气她父母；「他什么都沾，唯独不体面」，但把儿子带在身边当学徒。
facts.anchor: “My father was many things, but honorable was not one of them.

facts.fact: Ulises 母亲死于西班牙大流感——那个讲阿拉伯王子与瓶中精灵故事的母亲；两个孤儿在此对齐。
facts.anchor: “She passed away when I was small. The Spanish flu,” he said, thinking of her smiles and her stories about Arabian princes and genies in bottles.

facts.fact: 他对自己说太多真话感到警觉：父亲的信条「谁也别信」；他把 Inés 定性为「生意伙伴，不是哥们」（cronies）。
facts.anchor: Trust no one, his father had warned him. The mantra had served him well so far.

facts.fact: 新战术：办公室里指责 Perla「硬心肠」「拿人当金丝雀戏耍」——激将后强吻，她「慢吞吞地」才推开。
facts.anchor: There are women who will toy with a fellow’s heart with the ruthlessness of a cat stalking a canary.

facts.fact: 楼梯上向 Inés 交底：「饵下了，你姨妈似乎很受用」；并布置任务——清点银行账户、房产、保管箱。
facts.anchor: “The bait has been set,” he said.

facts.fact: 情报交割：Cándido 说的九万比索；Inés 查出实为两账户+Veracruz 保管箱共八万七千；姨妈书桌（锁死）里另有房契与现金。
facts.anchor: he said she had ninety thousand pesos in the bank.

facts.fact: 餐桌敲打：「男人知道待客何时被磨薄」，当众宣布要走——Perla 变脸。
facts.anchor: “Your aunt’s hospitality cannot be eternal,” he said, looking at Perla as he spoke.

facts.fact: 夜访：Perla 来敲门理论，他「强硬如索爱者」的吻后关门走人；自认「吻着姨妈想着侄女」的扭曲。
facts.anchor: What a twisted mind I have, he thought, kissing the aunt and thinking of the niece.

facts.fact: 危机：Cándido 提前三天回来，电报约见姨妈还带「大礼」——Inés 断定是订婚戒指。
facts.anchor: “Cándido is back in three days. You need to be quick.”

facts.fact: 反击：次日驱车进山求婚——母亲遗留下的婚戒「戴上或扔下山」，并成功说服 Perla 明天去 Las Tunas 民政登记。
facts.anchor: This belongs on your hand. Put it on if you’ll take me as your husband. If not, fling it away, down the mountain.

facts.fact: 车内圆房事成；他却在得意顶点想起 Inés 的笑，咽下嘴里那股苦味。
facts.anchor: Afterward, lying in the back of the car, with Perla’s hand skimming over his chest in postcoital gratification and his brow damp with sweat, he remembered how Inés had laughed, and swallowed the bitter taste in his mouth.
